root_cause: The native Envoy integration's entity set (reserve/battery/production/consumption sensors) goes unavailable together at the same minute every night (about 23:04-23:09 CDT) for roughly 20-55 min, then recovers on its own. It is an Envoy/integration-side availability drop, not a URA reload or HA restart; the fix lives with the integration/upstream (or is accepted), not in URA.

The native Envoy entities go unavailable together while the second-path '_2' entities mostly stay available (10-28, 10-30, 10-31), and URA's envoy_status goes offline/stale
